task.title: Package the Python engine to run in the browser
task.description:
**Conditional.** Only needed if the Pyodide spike decides to keep Python. Delete this story if the spike chooses the TypeScript port.

## Why
The spike proves the idea with throwaway code. This makes it a maintained part of the site.

## Steps
1. Add a build step that bundles the engine modules from `rebuild/` into one file the site serves.
2. Load Pyodide in a Web Worker at a pinned version. Decide whether to serve the runtime from the site or from its CDN, and record why.
3. Expose one call to the page: give it the fetched data and the chosen roster, get back the summary, board data and brief.
4. Leave out what the browser cannot use: `requests`, threads, the disk cache, the crawler, the benchmark builder and PDF export.
5. Have the browser cache the runtime so repeat visits skip the download.
6. Run the committed fixtures through the packaged engine in the pull request checks.

## Done when
- A fixture's inputs produce the recorded outputs when run through the packaged engine in a browser test.
- A repeat visit loads the runtime from the browser's cache.
